verdict.rationale: The ClickUp developer portal lists a first-party capability to "Trigger workflows from ClickUp events" alongside its Public API, MCP server and OAuth entries, which suggests event subscriptions for programmatic consumers. However, the evidence never explicitly says webhooks, registrable endpoints or outbound HTTP callbacks. The Slack, Discord and n8n integrations do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook registration (create/list/delete endpoints), the supported event types, payload format, signature verification and retry behavior, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
